Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC1; US1 AC2; US4 AC1; US4 AC2
Title: Validate one mapped total-loss Kind of Loss
Description: Verify that one Kind of Loss classified as total loss in the approved CSR-688 mapping produces the mapped FIRST_PARTY_VEHICLE_TOTAL_LOSS_INDICATOR.
Preconditions / Test Data: Obtain the approved Jira/CSR-688 mapping image as a readable table. Prepare a first-party claim record with an exact mapped total-loss Kind of Loss and record its unique claim and vehicle identifiers.
Steps: 1. Confirm the selected Kind of Loss and approved indicator in the CSR-688 mapping. 2. Insert, stage, or generate one claim record for the selected mapping row. 3. Process the GISA PPV claim. 4. Inspect source Kind of Loss and FIRST_PARTY_VEHICLE_TOTAL_LOSS_INDICATOR in the applicable database and output locations. 5. Reconcile the output indicator to the mapping row.
Expected Results: The processed claim uses the approved total-loss indicator exactly as specified in the mapping. The source Kind of Loss and indicator remain associated with the same claim and vehicle. No value is inferred from narrative text or another mapping.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC1; US1 AC3; US4 AC1; US4 AC2
Title: Validate one mapped non-total-loss Kind of Loss
Description: Verify that one Kind of Loss classified as non-total loss in the approved mapping produces its exact mapped indicator.
Preconditions / Test Data: Obtain the approved mapping table. Prepare a first-party claim record with an exact mapped non-total-loss Kind of Loss and unique claim and vehicle identifiers.
Steps: 1. Confirm the selected Kind of Loss and approved indicator in the CSR-688 mapping. 2. Prepare and process the claim record. 3. Inspect source, staged, persisted, and generated indicator values as available. 4. Compare the indicator with the exact mapping row.
Expected Results: The indicator equals the approved non-total-loss value for the selected Kind of Loss. It is linked to the correct claim and vehicle and is not defaulted to the total-loss value.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC4; US4 AC1; US4 AC2
Title: Validate every row in the approved Kind of Loss mapping
Description: Confirm complete coverage of the CSR-693 mapping without missing or duplicate rows.
Preconditions / Test Data: Use the readable approved CSR-688/Jira mapping as an exact expected dataset. Prepare at least one valid first-party claim record for every mapping row and record the expected indicator and unique claim/vehicle key for each row.
Steps: 1. Count and list every mapping row and expected indicator. 2. Prepare one claim for each mapping row. 3. Process all records. 4. Match each output to its source claim and exact Kind of Loss. 5. Compare the result for every mapping row and identify missing, extra, duplicated, or mismatched rows.
Expected Results: All mapping rows have one validated claim result with the exact approved indicator. No source mapping row is omitted, duplicated, broadened, or replaced by an inferred value.
Test Type: Positive; Boundary; Data Validation; Database Validation

Title: Validate indicator with correct claim and vehicle association in a mixed batch
Description: Verify that mixed claims with different Kind of Loss values receive their own mapped indicators and do not cross-contaminate one another.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare a batch containing at least three distinct claims: one mapped total-loss Kind of Loss, one mapped non-total-loss Kind of Loss, and one mapped record with a different Kind of Loss if available. Assign unique claim and vehicle keys and distinct source values.
Steps: 1. Confirm each mapping value before processing. 2. Insert or stage the mixed records with unique keys. 3. Run the normal GISA PPV claim processing flow. 4. Inspect selected database rows by claim and vehicle key. 5. Compare each output indicator with its own mapping row.
Expected Results: Each claim and vehicle receives the indicator mapped to its own Kind of Loss. No indicator or source value is copied from another record in the batch.

Title: Verify database joins do not associate another claim's Kind of Loss
Description: Detect incorrect joins, missing keys, or loose filters that could select a Kind of Loss or indicator from another claim.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare at least two claims and vehicles with different approved Kind of Loss values. Distinguish the source values and identifiers sufficiently to detect cross-record selection. Confirm the implementation's actual record keys and processing boundaries.
Steps: 1. Trace one target claim from source through staging and output. 2. Inspect join predicates and selected source keys using approved database validation methods. 3. Query sibling claims processed in the same batch. 4. Compare every source/output association.
Expected Results: The target query and joins select Kind of Loss only from the target claim and vehicle. No sibling claim's source fields or mapped indicator are assigned to the target record.

Title: Verify deterministic indicator processing for unchanged inputs
Description: Confirm repeated processing produces the same indicator for the same claim, mapping, and source data.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare a claim with an exact mapped Kind of Loss. Record the source and approved expected indicator. Keep source data and mapping unchanged between runs.
Steps: 1. Process the target claim and capture database and output values. 2. Process the same claim again without input changes. 3. Compare the indicators and record associations from both runs.
Expected Results: Both runs produce the same approved indicator for the same claim and vehicle. No unexplained variation, nulling, or row association change occurs.

Title: Validate unmapped Kind of Loss preserves approved baseline behavior
Description: Ensure a Kind of Loss absent from the CSR-693 mapping does not receive an inferred result.
Preconditions / Test Data: Identify an approved unmapped Kind of Loss and document the existing baseline indicator. If the baseline is unavailable, mark the case blocked and obtain it before execution.
Steps: 1. Confirm the selected Kind of Loss is absent from the approved CSR-693 mapping. 2. Capture baseline source and output values. 3. Process the unmapped claim without changing source data. 4. Compare the indicator with the approved existing baseline.
Expected Results: The indicator follows the separately approved baseline and does not receive a fabricated CSR-693 mapping value. If no baseline exists, the result is recorded as requiring approval and not treated as a pass.

Title: Validate similar but unmapped Kind of Loss does not infer by pattern
Description: Verify the mapping does not use prefix matching, ranges, or similarity to assign an indicator.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare a valid Kind of Loss that resembles a mapped value but is not present in the approved mapping. Obtain approved baseline behavior and identify both values clearly.
Steps: 1. Confirm the unmapped test value is not an exact mapping key. 2. Record baseline behavior. 3. Process the claim. 4. Compare source and indicator values to the approved mapping and baseline.
Expected Results: The process does not infer the indicator from similarity, prefix, numeric range, or loss-category grouping. The result follows the approved baseline; otherwise the case is marked blocked pending requirements.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US4 AC3; US1 AC2; US1 AC3
Title: Validate both total-loss and non-total-loss outcome groups
Description: Ensure data validation covers both outcome groups represented in the approved mapping.
Preconditions / Test Data: Obtain at least one approved mapping row for each outcome group, if the mapping defines them. Prepare one distinct claim per outcome group with unique identifiers.
Steps: 1. Confirm the approved indicator category and expected value for each selected row. 2. Process both claims in one run or separate runs. 3. Inspect source and output values. 4. Compare each indicator with its mapping group and exact row.
Expected Results: Both total-loss and non-total-loss mapping groups are exercised, each producing its exact approved indicator and remaining associated with the correct claim.

Title: Trace database source Kind of Loss through staged and final indicator
Description: Perform end-to-end traceability from the source loss value to the generated indicator using the implementation's actual schema.
Preconditions / Test Data: Use a mapped test claim. Identify actual source, staging, processing, persisted, and output locations with approved database access. Record the exact claim, vehicle, and Kind of Loss keys.
Steps: 1. Query the source record and capture Kind of Loss and identifiers. 2. Trace any staging or transformation rows to the processed claim. 3. Inspect the mapped indicator at each applicable persistence boundary. 4. Reconcile the final indicator to the source mapping row and output.
Expected Results: The same claim and vehicle can be traced through every applicable database stage. Kind of Loss and indicator reconcile to the correct mapping row without an unexplained value change, substitute record, or missing key.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US2 AC1; US2 AC3; US4 AC2
Title: Detect cross-record indicator duplication in an ordered batch
Description: Verify indicators are not duplicated from the preceding or following record when processing ordered claim rows.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare at least three claims with different mapped Kind of Loss values, including distinct approved indicators, and place them in adjacent processing order. Use unique claim and vehicle keys.
Steps: 1. Record source mapping rows and identifiers for all three claims. 2. Process the ordered batch. 3. Inspect database and output indicators in processing order. 4. Compare each row by key and exact source Kind of Loss.
Expected Results: Each output indicator matches its own source record; no result is reused from the preceding row, following row, default record, or cached claim.

Title: Verify database storage data type and representation for the indicator field
Description: Confirm FIRST_PARTY_VEHICLE_TOTAL_LOSS_INDICATOR is stored and emitted without incorrect nulls, coercion, trimming, or truncation.
Preconditions / Test Data: Use a mapped claim and inspect the implementation's approved field data type, precision, nullability, and output serialization. Expected representation must be confirmed from the mapping and output contract.
Steps: 1. Inspect the actual field metadata at every relevant database boundary. 2. Process the test claim. 3. Query the stored or staged indicator. 4. Compare type, precision, null/blank representation, and output serialization with the approved mapping.
Expected Results: The indicator retains the exact approved representation through storage and output. No unintended type conversion, truncation, trimming, blank/null substitution, or numeric coercion occurs.

Title: Validate database key selection for claim and vehicle record grain
Description: Confirm the indicator calculation uses the intended claim and vehicle key rather than a policy or unrelated exposure key.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare a claim with multiple vehicle or exposure records, if supported. Use distinct Kind of Loss values and approved mapping results at each record where appropriate. Record the intended output grain.
Steps: 1. Confirm the claim, vehicle, exposure, and processing grain expected by the implementation. 2. Process the prepared claim. 3. Inspect joins and selected source keys. 4. Compare each output indicator with its own source record.
Expected Results: The indicator is selected at the approved claim/vehicle grain and uses the Kind of Loss from that record. Data from sibling vehicles, exposures, or policies cannot be substituted.

Title: Run regression for out-of-scope claims
Description: Confirm CSR-693 does not alter indicators for representative claims outside its mapping scope.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare approved existing claims outside the CSR-693 mapping scope. Capture baseline source, indicator, and output before the change or using an approved regression baseline.
Steps: 1. Obtain baseline results for each out-of-scope claim. 2. Process identical source data in the updated flow. 3. Compare all indicators and record associations to baseline. 4. Investigate any changed result.
Expected Results: Out-of-scope claims retain their approved baseline indicators. Any change is limited to explicitly mapped CSR-693 records and has separate approved support.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC4; US4 AC1; US4 AC4
Title: Stop mapping validation when approved mapping source is unavailable
Description: Prevent guessed or unverified expected results when the referenced Jira mapping image cannot be obtained.
Preconditions / Test Data: Start with the available CSR-693 context text only; confirm the referenced mapping image or readable CSR-688 table is not available in the implementation test environment.
Steps: 1. Attempt to obtain or open the referenced mapping image/table. 2. If it is unavailable, record each affected test scenario as blocked. 3. Document the missing source rather than inventing values. 4. Resume only after a readable approved mapping is supplied.
Expected Results: Exact mapping tests cannot pass without the approved source and are correctly marked blocked with the source gap documented. No test passes based on guessed Kind of Loss or indicator values.
